meta.title: Buyer sends a bulk counter offer to all vendors

plan.title: Buyer sends bulk counter offer to all RFQ vendors

steps.note: Start a new multi-stage event create flow.
Configure the event as an RFQ so the RFQ Settings menu is available.
Apply the RFQ pricing template before adding line items.
Add the item that vendors will bid on.
Commit a bidding schedule before publishing.
Invite several vendors so the bulk action has multiple recipients.
Publish the RFQ for vendor bidding.
Confirm the event reached a published project page.
Submit the first vendor's bid through the vendor portal.
Verify the first vendor bid was accepted.
Submit a second vendor's bid through the vendor portal.
Verify the second vendor bid was accepted.
Open the buyer's QCS containing the vendor bids.
Open the RFQ Settings action for sending one counter offer to all vendors.

args.goal: In the Send Bulk Counter Offer drawer, select the Price field, enter a valid new counter value, click Send Counter Offer, and verify the success tooltip and that the QCS shows the counter-offer request with original and counter values highlighted for every vendor.

steps.note: Complete the counter-offer configuration and submission, including the field, value, send control, success confirmation, and changed-value presentation.
Verify that both vendor columns display the requested-counter-offer tag.
